latestVersion.changelog:
Elite Longterm Memory 1.2.3 introduces a comprehensive memory system for AI agents with six integrated memory layers.

- Combines HOT RAM, vector search (LanceDB), Git-Notes knowledge graph, curated archives, cloud backup, and auto-extraction (Mem0).
- Ensures persistent and structured context across sessions, with both automated and human-curated long-term memory.
- Adds support for automatic fact extraction and massive token reduction via Mem0.
- Follows a write-ahead log protocol for reliable context retention.
- Includes detailed setup and agent operational instructions for each layer.
